name: Remote Directory Browser
description: Provides a controlled, source-neutral browser for choosing one folder from bounded remote directory snapshots without a native picker.

states: Inspect source identity, clickable breadcrumbs, bounded child folders, editable-path disclosure, explicit cancellation, and current-folder selection.
Inspect the last canonical directory snapshot retained while navigation is loading and every navigation or selection decision is disabled.
Inspect inline bounded failure recovery with the attempted absolute path and last canonical folder list still visible.
Inspect the complete directory browser interaction and actions in Simplified Chinese.

useWhen: A trusted adapter can provide bounded read-only folder snapshots but the initiating client cannot use the source machine's native folder picker.
A remote connection flow must let a person discover and select one folder after authentication.
avoidWhen: The initiating client can and should use a native local folder picker owned by the same machine.
The workflow needs file selection, file contents, folder creation, deletion, renaming, or any other filesystem mutation.
invariants: The component is controlled presentation only and grants no filesystem, transport, authentication, or durable Project authority.
Breadcrumb and child-folder navigation emit only paths supplied by the current canonical snapshot; editable paths remain explicit user input for the adapter to validate.
A navigation request keeps the last canonical snapshot visible, disables all navigation and selection decisions, and exposes bounded progress.
A failed navigation retains the last canonical snapshot, attempted path, and a localized bounded reason without exposing provider diagnostics.
The browser exposes folders only and contains no file-content, filesystem-mutation, generic-command, or terminal behavior.
Folder rows use valid list semantics, every action is keyboard reachable, Enter submits an edited path, and Escape restores the canonical path draft.
